title: Best Flora AI Alternatives for Video Creators (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: Flora AI
tools.tagline: image-first canvas with Style DNA and a technique library
tools.claudeConnection: MCP and API documented by Flora at flora.ai/mcp
tools.modelSupport: Third-party image, video and text models on one canvas
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: florafauna.ai now redirects to flora.ai. Flora’s own homepage CTA is "Get started for free".

tools.name: Runway
tools.tagline: studio-grade video suite built around its own model family
tools.claudeConnection: First-party MCP server, run locally from Runway's own repo
tools.modelSupport: Runway's own model family plus third-party models, queryable at runtime

quickstart.label: The MCP server is not published to npm — clone and build it, then point your MCP config at `build/index.js`. Needs a Runway developer API key.
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/runwayml/runway-api-mcp-server
cd runway-api-mcp-server
npm install
npm run build

quickstart.label: The official SDKs cover the same API without MCP:
quickstart.code:
npm install @runwayml/sdk   # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-node
pip install runwayml         # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-python

tools.name: Krea AI
tools.tagline: real-time generation suite with node apps
tools.modelSupport: Krea’s hosted image and video models

tools.name: LTX Studio
tools.modelSupport: Lightricks’ own video models inside a storyboard-first editor
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: ltx.studio redirects to ltx.io/studio. The site blocked automated fetches, so no developer-docs or pricing URL could be confirmed — start from the homepage.

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.tagline: short-form video dashboard with camera motion presets
tools.claudeConnection: First-party hosted MCP connector, plus an official CLI
tools.modelSupport: 40+ models per the official CLI README

quickstart.label: Install the official CLI, authenticate, and generate:
quickstart.code:
npm install -g @higgsfield/cli
higgsfield auth login
higgsfield generate create nano_banana_2 --prompt "a quiet beach at sunrise" --wait

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server — community servers wrap a local instance
tools.modelSupport: Any checkpoint, LoRA or custom node you install locally
tools.note: Open source and self-hosted, so the software is free and you supply the GPU. The repo moved from comfyanonymous/ComfyUI to Comfy-Org/ComfyUI; the old path still redirects.
